title: TikTok: What does it cost to become a pilot? v2 (USD, hook, loop)

lines.text: Becoming an airline pilot can cost almost a quarter million dollars. Here is the receipt.
Medical exam and test fees: up to twenty-five hundred dollars.
Flight school: up to two hundred thousand.
Two years of rent and food? Not even included.
And many airlines want a type rating: another forty-five thousand.
And all of that before your first paycheck. Would you pay it?
